title: Accountable terminates verification services for MainStreet
description: Accountable ended its service relationship with MainStreet after stating that MainStreet did not meet its verification standards, removing the previously available public reserve-verification path.
notes: This establishes loss of public verification visibility, not a confirmed reserve deficit or insolvency.

title: msUSD suffers severe market depeg
description: msUSD traded materially below its intended one-dollar peg after the verification-provider termination, with reporting placing the intraday low near nine cents.
notes: A rebound from the low is not treated as sustainable peg recovery. Market price is distinct from verified direct-redemption value.
